property_summary: For any caller and any uint _val, once the contract has been initialized (Initialized() called), calling SetMinSum(_val) must revert (i.e., not succeed) and thus MinSum remains unchanged; the mutant removed that guard so after initialization SetMinSum may succeed and change MinSum.
change_summary: Replace the initialization check so SetMinSum always sets MinSum regardless of intitalized by removing the guard (delete the revert check).
